name: Xanathar's Guide to Everything — Tables
_note: Xanathar's Guide to Everything is 2014-era D&D content, converted as published for use alongside the 2024 rules. Subclass features are listed at their 2014 levels (a 2024 character picks a subclass at level 3 and gains any earlier features at once), and the prose cites 2014 class features and terminology. Where the 2024 Player's Handbook reprinted a subclass, both versions are offered and this one is tagged with its pack. Nothing here has been rewritten to match the 2024 rules — check with your table before using it.
